name: Define Intent
purpose: Turn the Design Brief and the pinned current facts into a bounded, testable definition of what this Intent must achieve without performing requirements, architecture, or build planning work.
completion_criteria: The Intent purpose, expected outcomes, in-scope work, out-of-scope work, success signals, and known unknowns are explicit and internally consistent.
The canonical Intent Definition pins the Design Brief and ST-01 Current Context by project-relative path and SHA-256.
The definition contains no route instruction, architecture choice, requirements detail, implementation plan, secret-bearing field, or unverified Core authority.
Core records ST-02 completion and advances only through the fixed ST-02 to ST-03 Graph edge.
stop_conditions: The Design Brief, Current Context, Effective Policy, Work Request, Plan, or Core State is missing, malformed, tampered, or inconsistent.
The proposed scope overlaps its exclusions, required outcomes or success signals are empty, or the proposal expands into a later Stage.
A value judgment, priority choice, or ambiguity cannot be resolved from the supplied human request and pinned current facts.
Core cannot acquire the Workspace lock or persist canonical JSON, Audit, and State records.
